evidenceBoundary.exact: Current named reader identities, complete selected unwind families, scoped static MethodSpecs, full list argument names, and normal-path source read order and scalar advances.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Initialized metadata/class state, nonnull wrappers/instances/formatters, sufficient contiguous buffered bytes, disabled reference barriers, compatible selected nested formatters, ordinary Win64 ABI and normal callees.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Concrete live formatter/provider selection, refill/cold parity, segment replacement, runtime source selection, and whole-BuffData EOF.

family.evidenceBoundary: Exact declared exception-table framing and complete parent triples establish selected-primary range membership, including nested and noncontiguous chains. Version 1/2 code-slot contents, fixed-allocation consistency, handlers, managed control flow, live MethodInfo and execution remain separate proofs; adjacency and start-address-only joins are not used.
